blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Philippine Embassy in Madrid confirmed on Wednesday that a Filipino was among those injured in a deadly train crash in Spain that killed at least 68 people. The Filipino sustained minor injuries and was brought to a hospital for medical attention, according to the embassy. “As of this time, we have verified information of one (1) Filipino national who sustained minor injury and was brought to a hospital for medical attention,” the embassy said in a statement.
